title: Design System: Public Service Briefing Folio

display.purpose: Page propositions and major section arguments; capped at 6rem.

body.purpose: Fast, warm reading for evidence and operational prose.

label.purpose: Compact evidence, stage, and action language.

shadows.name: mobile-menu-overlay
shadows.purpose: Temporary mobile navigation overlay only; documentary surfaces remain flat.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable nonessential animation and smooth scrolling when requested.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Square, high-contrast next action for product proof and contact paths.
components.css: .ds-action-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:3rem; padding:.8rem 1.15rem; border:2px solid #101b20; border-radius:0; background:#101b20; color:#fffdf7; font:750 1rem/1.15 Karla,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-action-primary:hover { background:#0e62a3; border-color:#0e62a3; } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #d7a615; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Square paper action for a supporting route.
components.css: .ds-action-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:3rem; padding:.8rem 1.15rem; border:2px solid #101b20; border-radius:0; background:#fffdf7; color:#101b20; font:750 1rem/1.15 Karla,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-action-secondary:hover { background:#f4c447; } .ds-action-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #d7a615; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Evidence Rail
components.description: Ink field with signal-yellow numerals and ruled lifecycle stages.
components.css: .jb-product-hero-rail { background:#101b20; color:#fffdf7; } .jb-product-hero-rail p { border-bottom:1px solid rgb(255 253 247 / .22); } .jb-product-hero-rail strong { color:#f4c447; }

components.name: Three-Stage Progress List
components.description: Responsive numbered stages for finding, testing, and sustaining the product path.
components.css: .jb-product-lanes li { border-top:2px solid #101b20; } .jb-product-lanes li > span { color:#c63b21; }

components.name: Casebook Band
components.description: Full-width dark field combining bounded product language, governed photography, captions, and proof links.
components.css: .jb-casebook { background:#18252a; color:#fffdf7; } .jb-case-feature { border-top:1px solid rgb(255 253 247 / .25); border-radius:0; box-shadow:none; }

components.name: Delivery Ledger
components.description: Rule-separated rows connecting operating capability to named evidence and deeper routes.
components.css: .jb-delivery-ledger article { border-top:1px solid rgb(16 27 32 / .28); border-radius:0; box-shadow:none; }

components.name: Briefing Navigation
components.description: Compact portfolio routes with Product Delivery foregrounded and visible keyboard focus.
components.css: nav a { color:#101b20; text-decoration:none; } nav a:hover { color:#0e62a3; text-decoration:underline; } nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #d7a615; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: A composed briefing for public-sector product hiring panels. Complicated public work becomes traceable decisions, sequenced delivery, and usable systems through evidence rails and generous documentary fields.
keyCharacteristics: Complicated public work becomes traceable decisions and usable systems.
Evidence rails expose sequence, proof, and ownership.
Generous documentary fields protect consequential language from decorative clutter.
Product ownership, public-service judgment, and shipping fluency are legible on the first surface.
Photography operates as governed evidence, not wallpaper.

rules.name: Evidence Rail
rules.body: Every major surface exposes sequence, proof, or ownership through numbered progress marks, ruled rows, lifecycle rails, or decision ledgers.

rules.name: Folio Field
rules.body: Consequential language receives generous space. Decorative cards do not fill the field.

rules.name: Signal Color
rules.body: Yellow and rose indicate action, progression, or evidence; they are never confetti.

rules.name: Rules Before Shadows
rules.body: If a boundary can be communicated with a rule or tonal field, a shadow is forbidden.

dos: Make Jamie's product role, decisions, handoffs, and bounded proof immediately scannable.
Preserve collective credit, governed photography, descriptive captions, and public-safe evidence boundaries.
Use flat color fields, fine rules, lifecycle marks, and delivery ledgers as the signature vocabulary.
donts: Do not use eyebrows above headings, generic card grids, pills, gradients, fake technical chrome, authority-by-association, or decorative metrics.
Do not publish private correspondence, raw records, internal analytics, archive locators, or unapproved material.
Do not infer production publication or indexing approval from access, evaluation, staging, or repository inclusion.
